title: SwarmEvolve Tactic Detector Event (M18)
description: One JSON Lines record emitted by scripts/tactic_detector.py to `tactic_events.jsonl`. Each record is a first-appearance event for a named tactic (flanking, kiting, focus_fire_discipline, message_coded_targeting). All thresholds are frozen in scripts/tactic_detector.py — any change bumps `schema_version`. See NEXT_PHASE_PLAN.md §M18 for the detector semantics.

schema_version.description: Tactic-event schema version. The M18 initial release is 1.

first_tick.description: Zero-indexed tick at which the qualifying condition first became continuously true for this detector. Interpretation per tactic: flanking = start of the ≥90° streak; kiting = start of the ≥100-tick retreat streak; focus_fire_discipline = the tick at which the 200-attempt rolling window first dropped to ≤10% redundant; message_coded_targeting = first tick with any alive-drone target observation.

sustained_ticks.description: Duration metric associated with the event. For flanking/kiting this is the consecutive-tick streak length at firing. For focus_fire_discipline this is FF_WINDOW_ATTEMPTS (the rolling window size). For message_coded_targeting this is the total number of observation ticks in the NMI window.

track.description: Experimental track (e.g. A/B/C) or empty string when running ad-hoc.

model.description: Model identifier that authored the AI under review.

generation.description: Generation index within the lineage; -1 when unspecified.

perspective.description: Which team we scored the detector from.

evidence.description: Detector-specific payload. Keys vary by tactic but every detector must include its triggering threshold for auditability. Examples: flanking → {angle_deg, cluster_sizes, threshold_angle_deg, threshold_streak_ticks}; kiting → {kiting_fraction, max_kiting_fraction, threshold_fraction, threshold_streak_ticks, cos_min}; focus_fire_discipline → {redundant_ratio, window_attempts, threshold_max_ratio}; message_coded_targeting → {best_channel, nmi, target_events, observation_ticks, threshold_nmi}.
